message.content:
Search this repository (/bench/repo) for markdown processing that sits behind an interface. I need to find:

1. The interface/abstraction that markdown processing sits behind (e.g., a `MarkdownRenderer` interface, `IMarkdown`, trait, abstract class, protocol, etc.)
2. The concrete implementation(s) of that interface that execute at runtime (e.g., a class wrapping a specific markdown library like markdown-it, marked, remark, commonmark, etc.)
3. Who constructs those implementations (factory, DI container, direct instantiation, provider — where is `new SomeMarkdownImpl()` called or registered)
4. Which components hold/consume the interface (fields typed as the interface, constructor params, injected dependencies)

Search broadly across naming conventions (Markdown, markdown, Md, MD, renderer, parser, processor, formatter). Report exact file paths and line numbers for: the interface definition, each concrete implementation, the construction sites, and the holding components. Be very thorough.

content.text:
I have a complete picture. The clear abstraction is on the Go backend; the frontend uses react-markdown/remark directly (concrete, no interface). Here is my report.

## Summary

The markdown processing abstraction lives on the Go backend as the `markdown.Service` interface, backed by the `goldmark` library. The React frontend does its own rendering directly via `react-markdown`/`remark` with no equivalent interface indirection.

## 1. The interface / abstraction

- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:31` — `type Service interface` (the `markdown.Service` abstraction). Methods: `ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`, `GenerateSnippet`, `ValidateContent`, `RenameTag`.

## 2. Concrete implementation(s)

- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:58` — `type service struct { md goldmark.Markdown }`. This unexported struct is the single runtime implementation, wrapping the `github.com/yuin/goldmark` library (imported at lines 7-12). Method implementations run from lines 143-453 (`RenderHTML` at :255 uses `goldmark`'s `Convert`; `parse` at :116 uses `s.md.Parser().Parse`).
- Supporting helper (not itself an implementation of the interface, but the AST-to-markdown renderer used by `RenderMarkdown`/`RenameTag`): `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:15` — `type MarkdownRenderer struct`, constructed via `NewMarkdownRenderer()` at :20, invoked at `markdown.go:250` and `markdown.go:451`.
- goldmark extensions/parsers that plug into the concrete service: `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/extensions/tag.go`, `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/extensions/mention.go`, `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/parser/tag.go`, `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/parser/mention.go`, `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/ast/tag.go`, `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/ast/mention.go`.

## 3. Who constructs the implementation

The factory is `NewService(opts ...Option) Service` at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:85` (returns `&service{md: md}` at :110). It configures goldmark with GFM plus optional tag/mention extensions (options `WithTagExtension` :71, `WithMentionExtension` :78).

Production construction sites (direct instantiation — no DI container):
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48` — `markdown.NewService(markdown.WithTagExtension(), markdown.WithMentionExtension())` inside `NewAPIV1Service`; assigned to `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` at :56. This is the primary/root instance.
- `/bench/repo/server/server.go:76` calls `apiv1.NewAPIV1Service(...)`, then `/bench/repo/server/server.go:85` passes `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` into `rss.NewRSSService(...)` — i.e., the same instance is shared, not re-constructed.

Test-only construction sites:
- `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss_test.go:54`
- `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go:427`
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`
- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown_test.go` (many, e.g. :11, :156, :310, :344).

## 4. Components that hold / consume the interface

Fields typed as `markdown.Service`:
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35` — `APIV1Service.MarkdownService markdown.Service` (the owning holder).
- `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:45` — `RSSService.MarkdownService markdown.Service`; constructor param at `rss.go:58` (`NewRSSService(..., markdownService markdown.Service)`), assigned :62; consumed at `rss.go:339` (`RenderHTML`).
- `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16` — `Runner.MarkdownService markdown.Service`; constructor `NewRunner(store, markdownService markdown.Service)` at :19, assigned :22; consumed at :52 and in free function `RebuildMemoPayload(_, memo, markdownService markdown.Service)` at :74 (`ExtractAll` at :80).

Consumers using the interface via `s.MarkdownService` (holding it through `APIV1Service`):
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447` — `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, ..., s.MarkdownService)`.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32` — `s.MarkdownService.ExtractAll(...)`.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:85` — `s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet(...)`.

## Frontend note (no interface abstraction)

The React side renders markdown directly, not behind an interface:
- `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/MemoMarkdownRenderer.tsx:4` imports `ReactMarkdown` from `react-markdown`; used at :144. It wires remark/rehype plugins (remark-gfm/math/breaks plus custom plugins in `/bench/repo/web/src/utils/remark-plugins/` and `/bench/repo/web/src/utils/rehype-plugins/`) and maps AST nodes to React components. `MemoMarkdownRendererProps` (:28) is just a props type, not a renderer abstraction.
- Related frontend files: `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/index.tsx`, `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/MarkdownRenderContext.tsx`, and the per-node components under `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/markdown/`.

So if "the interface markdown processing sits behind" means a swappable abstraction, the answer is exclusively the Go `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`) with its single goldmark-backed `service` implementation.
